```{r}
data_raw <- read_excel("2020-2025 mole crabs.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    water_temp = as.numeric(str_extract(water_temp, "[0-9.]+")),
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = factor(year(date))
  )
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # ---------------------------
    # Standardize Location Names
    # ---------------------------
    location = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(location), "brighton|bluff") ~ "bluffs",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "south bath|bath ave") ~ "south_bath",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "deal|allenhurst|roosevelt") ~ "deal",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "ocean grove") ~ "ocean_grove",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "sandy hook") ~ "sandy_hook",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ---------------------------
    # Clean Waves
    # ---------------------------
    waves_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "small|\\bsm\\b") ~ "Small",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "med") ~ "Medium",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "large|rough|3-5") ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ---------------------------
    # Clean Zone (collapse surf into swash)
    # ---------------------------
    zone = tolower(zone),
    zone = case_when(
      str_detect(zone, "bore")  ~ "bore",
      str_detect(zone, "swash") ~ "swash",
      str_detect(zone, "surf")  ~ "swash",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ---------------------------
    # Clean Environmental Variables
    # ---------------------------
    salinity = as.numeric(str_extract(salinity, "[0-9.]+")),
    do_mg_l_raw = as.numeric(str_extract(do_mg_l, "[0-9.]+")),
    air_temp_deg_c = as.numeric(str_extract(air_temp_deg_c, "[0-9.]+"))
  ) %>%
  
  # ---------------------------
  # Fix Impossible DO Values
  # ---------------------------
  mutate(
    do_mg_l = case_when(
      do_mg_l_raw > 20 ~ NA_real_,   # remove biologically impossible values
      do_mg_l_raw <= 0 ~ NA_real_,   # remove impossible zero/negative DO
      TRUE ~ do_mg_l_raw
    )
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::select(-do_mg_l_raw) %>%
  
  # Keep only valid locations
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%
  
  mutate(
    location = factor(location),
    year = factor(year, levels = sort(unique(year))),
    waves_clean = factor(waves_clean,
                         levels = c("Small","Medium","Large")),
    zone = factor(zone,
                  levels = c("bore","swash"))
  ) %>%
  
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
```
```{r}
# CREATE LONG FORMAT SIZE DATA
# ----------------------------------

temp_mean <- mean(clean_data$water_temp, na.rm = TRUE)

size_data <- clean_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    water_temp,
    salinity,
    do_mg_l,
    air_temp_deg_c,
    waves_clean,
    location,
    year,
    zone,
    groin,            
    scoops,
    ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    ct_2mm  = as.numeric(ct_2mm),
    ct_6mm  = as.numeric(ct_6mm),
    ct_12mm = as.numeric(ct_12mm),
    
    # Clean  
    groin = case_when(
      groin %in% c("N","n") ~ "North",
      groin %in% c("S","s") ~ "South",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm),
    names_to = "size_class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    size_class = factor(
      size_class,
      levels = c("ct_2mm","ct_6mm","ct_12mm"),
      labels = c("Small (2mm)",
                 "Medium (6mm)",
                 "Large (12mm+)")
    ),
    
    water_temp_c = water_temp - temp_mean,
    
    count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South"))
  ) %>%
  
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# OBSERVED TEMPORAL TREND
# ----------------------------------

raw_year <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- Compute TOTAL decline ----
raw_total <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_total = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE))

decline_percent <-
  (1 - raw_total$mean_total[raw_total$year == "2024"] /
        raw_total$mean_total[raw_total$year == "2021"]) * 100

decline_label <- paste0("~", round(decline_percent,0),
                        "% decline across size classes")

ggplot() +
  
  # ---- Raw data points (jittered) ----
  geom_jitter(
    data = size_data,
    aes(x = year,
        y = count + 0.1,  # small offset to avoid log(0)
        color = size_class),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  
  # ---- SE ribbon ----
  geom_ribbon(
    data = raw_year,
    aes(x = year,
        ymin = mean_count - se,
        ymax = mean_count + se,
        fill = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean line ----
  geom_line(
    data = raw_year,
    aes(x = year,
        y = mean_count,
        color = size_class,
        group = size_class),
    linewidth = 1.6
  ) +
  
  # ---- Mean points ----
  geom_point(
    data = raw_year,
    aes(x = year,
        y = mean_count,
        color = size_class),
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  # ---- Nourishment marker ----
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = which(levels(size_data$year) == "2024"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  
  # Disturbance label
  annotate("text",
           x = 4.8,
           y = max(raw_year$mean_count) * 1.8,
           label = "Beach Nourishment Disturbance",
           color = "red",
           size = 5,
           fontface = "bold",
           hjust = 1) +
  
  # Decline label
  annotate("text",
           x = 4.8,
           y = max(raw_year$mean_count) * 1.3,
           label = decline_label,
           color = "red",
           size = 5,
           fontface = "bold",
           hjust = 1) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Observed Abundance (log scale)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Observed Temporal Trend in Mole Crab Abundance"
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE MODELING DATASET
# ----------------------------------

analysis_data <- size_data %>%
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  
  mutate(
    # Center date
    date_numeric = as.numeric(date),
    date_c = date_numeric - mean(date_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Center environmental predictors
    salinity_c = salinity - mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    do_c = do_mg_l - mean(do_mg_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    air_temp_c = air_temp_deg_c - mean(air_temp_deg_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South"))
  ) %>%
  
  drop_na(count, scoops, size_class, location, year) %>%
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# ENVIRONMENTAL VARIABLE SCREENING
# ==========================================

candidate_vars <- c("waves_clean",
                    "salinity",
                    "do_mg_l",
                    "air_temp_deg_c")

# Null model
nb_null <- glm.nb(
  count ~ 1 + offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_data
)

for (var in candidate_vars) {

  formula_str <- paste0("count ~ ", var, " + offset(log(scoops))")
  
  model <- try(
    glm.nb(as.formula(formula_str),
           data = analysis_data),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  cat("\n----------------------------------\n")
  cat("Variable:", var, "\n")
  
  if (!inherits(model, "try-error")) {
    print(summary(model)$coefficients)
    cat("AIC:", AIC(model), "\n")
    print(anova(nb_null, model, test = "LRT"))
  } else {
    cat("Model failed (missing data or sparse levels)\n")
  }
}
```


```{r}
nb_final <- glm.nb(
  count ~ water_temp_c +
          size_class +
          location * year +
          offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_data,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 200)
)

summary(nb_final)
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# INCIDENCE RATE RATIOS (IRR TABLE)
# ----------------------------------

coef_table <- summary(nb_final)$coefficients

irr_table <- as.data.frame(coef_table) %>%
  mutate(
    term = rownames(coef_table),
    IRR  = exp(Estimate),
    CI_low  = exp(Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
    CI_high = exp(Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(term, IRR, CI_low, CI_high, `Pr(>|z|)`) %>%
  rename(p_value = `Pr(>|z|)`) %>%
  arrange(term)

irr_table
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# TOTAL 2024 EFFECT BY LOCATION
# ----------------------------------

coefs <- coef(nb_final)

# Reference location (bluffs)
irr_bluffs_2024 <- exp(coefs["year2024"])

# Deal
irr_deal_2024 <- exp(coefs["year2024"] +
                     coefs["locationdeal:year2024"])

# South Bath
irr_south_bath_2024 <- exp(coefs["year2024"] +
                           coefs["locationsouth_bath:year2024"])

cat("2024 IRR (Bluffs):", round(irr_bluffs_2024, 3), "\n")
cat("2024 IRR (Deal):", round(irr_deal_2024, 3), "\n")
cat("2024 IRR (South Bath):", round(irr_south_bath_2024, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# MODEL COMPARISON
# ----------------------------------

# Additive model (no interactions)
nb_additive <- glm.nb(
  count ~ water_temp_c + size_class + location + year +
    offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_data
)

# No temperature model
nb_no_temp <- glm.nb(
  count ~ size_class + location + year +
    offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_data
)

# Model with continuous date
nb_with_date <- glm.nb(
  count ~ water_temp_c +
    date_c +
    size_class +
    location * year +
    offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_data
)

# Air temp model
nb_air_full <- glm.nb(
  count ~ water_temp_c +
          air_temp_c +
          size_class +
          location * year +
          offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_data %>% drop_na(air_temp_c)
)
summary(nb_air_full)

# DO Model
nb_do_full <- glm.nb(
  count ~ water_temp_c +
          do_c +
          size_class +
          location * year +
          offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_data %>% drop_na(do_c)
)
summary(nb_do_full)

# ----------------------------------
# AIC COMPARISON (Primary Models)
# ----------------------------------

AIC(nb_no_temp,
    nb_additive,
    nb_final,
    nb_with_date,
    nb_air_full,
    nb_do_full)

# ----------------------------------
# LIKELIHOOD RATIO TESTS
# ----------------------------------

# Does temperature improve model?
anova(nb_no_temp, nb_final, test = "LRT")

# Does continuous date improve model?
anova(nb_final, nb_with_date, test = "LRT")


# ==========================================
# 2020 Sensitivity Check
# ==========================================

# Include 2020 to test structural confounding
analysis_full <- size_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2020","2021","2022","2023","2024","2025")) %>%
  drop_na(count, water_temp_c, size_class, location, year, date, scoops) %>%
  droplevels()

nb_with_2020 <- glm.nb(
  count ~ water_temp_c +
    size_class +
    location * year +
    offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_full
)

# Compare AIC
AIC(nb_with_2020, nb_final)

# Compare via LRT
anova(nb_with_2020, nb_final, test = "LRT")
```

```{r}
nb_null_groin <- glm.nb(
  count ~ 1 + offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_groin
)

nb_groin_uni <- glm.nb(
  count ~ groin + offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_groin
)

cat("\n--- Univariate Groin Test ---\n")
print(AIC(nb_null_groin, nb_groin_uni))
print(anova(nb_null_groin, nb_groin_uni, test = "LRT"))

# ----------------------------------
# 2️⃣ Multivariate Test (Adjusted)
# ----------------------------------

nb_groin_base <- glm.nb(
  count ~ water_temp_c +
          size_class +
          location +
          year +
          offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_groin
)

nb_groin_full <- glm.nb(
  count ~ water_temp_c +
          size_class +
          location +
          year +
          groin +
          offset(log(scoops)),
  data = analysis_groin
)

cat("\n--- Adjusted Groin Test ---\n")
print(AIC(nb_groin_base, nb_groin_full))
print(anova(nb_groin_base, nb_groin_full, test = "LRT"))

# ----------------------------------
# 3️⃣ Effect Size (IRR)
# ----------------------------------

groin_coef <- summary(nb_groin_full)$coefficients["groinSouth", ]

groin_IRR  <- exp(groin_coef["Estimate"])
groin_low  <- exp(groin_coef["Estimate"] - 1.96 * groin_coef["Std. Error"])
groin_high <- exp(groin_coef["Estimate"] + 1.96 * groin_coef["Std. Error"])

cat("\nGroin (South vs North) IRR:",
    round(groin_IRR, 3),
    "CI:",
    round(groin_low, 3), "-",
    round(groin_high, 3), "\n")
```


```{r}
# ==========================================
# MODEL DIAGNOSTICS & ROBUSTNESS CHECKS
# ==========================================

# ---- 1. Overdispersion check (justify NB) ----
mean_count <- mean(analysis_data$count)
var_count  <- var(analysis_data$count)

cat("Mean count:", mean_count, "\n")
cat("Variance:", var_count, "\n")

poisson_test <- glm(count ~ water_temp_c + size_class + location * year,
                    family = poisson,
                    data = analysis_data)

dispersion <- sum(residuals(poisson_test, type="pearson")^2) /
              poisson_test$df.residual

cat("Poisson dispersion ratio:", dispersion, "\n")

# Interpretation guideline:
# dispersion > 1.5–2 indicates overdispersion → NB justified


# ---- 2. Temperature–Year confounding check ----
year_numeric <- as.numeric(analysis_data$year)

cor_test <- cor.test(analysis_data$water_temp_c,
                     year_numeric,
                     method = "spearman")

print(cor_test)


# ---- 3. Sampling effort by year ----
cat("\nSampling effort by year:\n")
print(table(analysis_data$year))


# ---- 4. Residual diagnostics ----
res <- residuals(nb_final, type = "pearson")
fit <- fitted(nb_final)

plot(fit, res,
     xlab = "Fitted values",
     ylab = "Pearson residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")


# ---- 5. Influence check (Cook's distance) ----
cooks <- cooks.distance(nb_final)

plot(cooks,
     type = "h",
     main = "Cook's Distance",
     ylab = "Influence")

abline(h = 4/length(cooks), col = "red")

# ---- 6. Temporal Autocorrelation Check ----

# Order data by date and attach Pearson residuals
analysis_data_ordered <- analysis_data %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    pearson_resid = residuals(nb_final, type = "pearson")
  )

# ----------------------------------
# Residuals Over Time
# ----------------------------------

plot(analysis_data_ordered$date,
     analysis_data_ordered$pearson_resid,
     type = "b",
     pch = 16,
     main = "Pearson Residuals Over Time",
     xlab = "Date",
     ylab = "Pearson Residuals")

abline(h = 0, col = "red")

# ----------------------------------
# Autocorrelation Function (ACF)
# ----------------------------------

acf(analysis_data_ordered$pearson_resid,
    main = "ACF of Pearson Residuals")
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# TEMPORAL TREND
# ----------------------------------

model_data <- analysis_data

pred_vals <- predict(
  nb_final,
  type = "link",
  se.fit = TRUE
)

model_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(
    fit_link = pred_vals$fit,
    se_link  = pred_vals$se.fit,
    fit      = exp(fit_link),
    lwr      = exp(fit_link - 1.96 * se_link),
    upr      = exp(fit_link + 1.96 * se_link)
  )

year_effect <- model_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fit = mean(fit),
    mean_lwr = mean(lwr),
    mean_upr = mean(upr),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate 2024 decline relative to 2021
decline_df <- year_effect %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2024")) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, size_class, mean_fit) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year,
              values_from = mean_fit)

decline_df$percent_decline <-
  (1 - (decline_df$`2024` /
        decline_df$`2021`)) * 100

overall_decline <- round(mean(decline_df$percent_decline), 0)

decline_label <- paste0(
  "~", overall_decline,
  "% decline across size classes"
)

# ----------------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------------

ggplot(year_effect,
       aes(x = year,
           y = mean_fit,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_lwr,
                  ymax = mean_upr),
              alpha = 0.15,
              color = NA) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  # Disturbance line
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = which(levels(year_effect$year) == "2024"),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10() +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  
  # Disturbance annotation
  annotate("text",
           x = which(levels(year_effect$year) == "2024") - 0.1,
           y = max(year_effect$mean_fit) * 1.8,
           label = "Beach Nourishment Disturbance",
           color = "red",
           size = 5,
           fontface = "bold",
           hjust = 1) +
  
  # Decline annotation
  annotate("text",
           x = 1,
           y = max(year_effect$mean_fit) * 1.4,
           label = decline_label,
           color = "red",
           size = 5,
           fontface = "bold",
           hjust = -0.6) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Model-Adjusted Mole Crab Abundance (log scale)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Modeled Temporal Trend in Mole Crab Abundance"
  )
```

```{r}
# Get fitted values from model
model_data <- analysis_data

    fit_link = pred_vals$fit,

    water_temp = water_temp_c + temp_mean,

  )

# Summarize by temperature bin + size class
temp_effect <- model_data %>%
  group_by(temp_bin, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fit = mean(fit),
    mean_lwr = mean(lwr),
    mean_upr = mean(upr),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Extract temperature IRR from model
temp_IRR <- exp(coef(nb_final)["water_temp_c"])
percent_decline <- round((1 - temp_IRR) * 100, 0)

temp_label <- paste0(percent_decline,
                     "% average decline per 1°C increase")

# Plot

       aes(x = temp_bin,
           y = mean_fit,
           color = size_class,

  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +

    y = "Model-Adjusted Abundance (log scale)",
    color = "Size Class",
    fill  = "Size Class",
    title = "Modeled Effect of Temperature on Mole Crab Abundance"
  )
```

```{r}
site_coords <- data.frame(
  location = c("sandy_hook","bluffs","south_bath","deal","ocean_grove"),
  lat = c(40.445, 40.300, 40.292, 40.245, 40.210),
  lon = c(-73.990, -74.000, -74.003, -74.025, -74.010)
)

site_summary <- left_join(site_summary, site_coords, by = "location")

# Clean labels
site_summary$location_clean <- dplyr::recode(site_summary$location,
  sandy_hook  = "Sandy Hook",
  bluffs      = "Bluffs",
  south_bath  = "South Bath",
  deal        = "Deal",
  ocean_grove = "Ocean Grove"
)

# ----------------------------------
# Label positioning (original spacing)
# ----------------------------------

site_summary <- site_summary %>%
  mutate(
    label_lon = lon - 0.025,
    label_lat = case_when(
      location == "sandy_hook" ~ lat + 0.01,
      location == "bluffs" ~ lat + 0.010,
      location == "south_bath" ~ lat - 0.010,
      location == "deal" ~ lat - 0.005,
      location == "ocean_grove" ~ lat - 0.008,
      TRUE ~ lat
    )
  )
```
